title: Session: version and verified GitHub history
objective: Check /version for all guild members: installed version 2.7.0, bounded recent GitHub history, linked commit IDs and titles, and green checkmarks only for verified signatures.
user: Run DevBot's `/version`. Confirm the heading shows v2.7.0 and up to five recent commits from connstructor/tarubot.
Run `/version commits:1` and `/version commits:10`. Check the result count and that every displayed commit ID opens its GitHub commit.
Compare the green checkmarks with GitHub's Verified status. A signed but unverified commit must not receive a green checkmark.
Have an ordinary non-officer guild member run `/version` to confirm access. Replies remain public in this development guild.
Send me the output or a screenshot. GitHub history may be cached for up to five minutes and reflects published commits on main.
assistant: Verify command registration, compiled version identity, commit-count bounds, GitHub links, and signature-badge mapping.
Check controlled outage, rate-limit, malformed-response, and unsigned/unverified fixtures; the local version must stay visible.
Record deployment and test results, commit the verified implementation, and summarize remaining requirement-delivery work.
bot: Show its installed SemVer from the compiled package manifest.
Fetch recent commits from GitHub with bounded, cached requests; show titles and linked short commit IDs.
Add ✅ next to an ID only when GitHub reports a valid verified signature.
Keep version information available with a useful message if GitHub history is unavailable.
